description: The published earn evidence still cannot be third-party-verified as REAL, GATE-0-classified profit -- REQ-702's own acceptance criterion ('third-party verifiability of "the balance grows" (this feature's stated purpose) is restored (FIND-001)', behavioral-spec.md:135-137) is false for the fix as implemented. `skills/_shared/lib/ledger.mjs::isProfitable(line)` (the repo's SINGLE source of truth classifier for whether an earn-ledger line counts as a genuine profitable wake, ledger.mjs:51-64) requires `line.external === true` unconditionally ('any line without external:true NEVER counts', ledger.mjs:50,55) plus one of: `tx && status==='0x1'` (EVM), `sig && confirmed===true` (Solana), or `chain==='hyperliquid' && fill_tid!=null && confirmed===true` (Hyperliquid). `projectEarnField()` (ledger-publish.mjs:261-280) DROPS `external`, `confirmed`, and `fill_tid` -- they are simply absent from the switch statement's case list and fall through to `default: return undefined`. The consequence: (1) EVERY published earn line evaluates `isProfitable()===false` regardless of real profitability, since `external` alone gates the whole function to false; (2) Solana lines additionally lose `confirmed`, so `solOk` can never be true even if external were present; (3) Hyperliquid lines lose BOTH `fill_tid` (their ONLY on-chain-equivalent settlement reference -- `tx`/`sig` do not apply to HL fills at all, per ledger.mjs:33-35/56-62) and `confirmed`, so an HL-sourced earn line is published with a dollar amount but literally ZERO verifiable settlement reference of any kind. A third party cloning `ledger-<instance>` branch can see `net_usdc` numbers but cannot run the project's own GATE-0 classifier against them and cannot distinguish a real external-revenue trade from an internal swap/wash-trade (`external:true` is precisely the field the codebase uses to make that distinction, ledger.mjs:39-46/54-55) -- the exact 'balance/actions grow, provably' claim this feature exists to satisfy (behavioral-spec.md:5-6) is not met. This is not an accidental oversight: verification-architecture.md:98 (proof obligation FIND-001a) explicitly documents 'drops confirmed/external/fill_tid/any other field outside the explicit list' as the INTENDED, tested behavior, and ledger-publish.test.mjs:214-229 asserts this omission as correct (`assert.ok(!('confirmed' in out) && !('external' in out) && !('fill_tid' in out), ...)`) -- the spec's own REQ-702 field list is incomplete relative to the real earn-ledger schema it claims to have 'verified live against skills/_shared/lib/ledger.mjs::deriveLine' (behavioral-spec.md:104-105), and the incompleteness was carried faithfully through code, spec and tests without anyone tracing it against `isProfitable()`, the actual downstream consumer of this exact schema.

corroborating.note: isProfitable(line): return false unconditionally if line.external !== true (line 55); evmOk/solOk/hlOk each additionally require tx+status, sig+confirmed, or fill_tid+confirmed respectively (lines 60-63) -- none of confirmed/external/fill_tid are in projectEarnField's allowlist.

writes confirmed:true on every recorded Solana line and explicitly documents NOT setting external:true for swaps (line 48-50) -- confirming `confirmed` is a real, populated field on real earn-ledger lines that the projection drops.

fill_tid is Hyperliquid's ONLY per-fill dedup/settlement id, written into every HL earn-ledger line (line 148) -- dropped entirely by projectEarnField, leaving HL earn lines with no verifiable settlement reference in the published feed at all.
FIND-001a proof obligation documents dropping confirmed/external/fill_tid as the intended, PASSing behavior -- the proof table proves the wrong invariant relative to the spec's own stated purpose.
asserts confirmed/external/fill_tid are absent from the published line as correct behavior -- the test codifies the gap rather than catching it.
